title: Missing GUI
description: Every GUI element is now a missing texture
body:
Missing GUI is a simple resource pack that replaces every single GUI element with the classic "missing texture" pattern.

For download different color click to versions

Features
✅ All inventory slots (main, hotbar, armor, crafting, etc.) replaced with purple & black checkerboard grid

✅ Clean, minimalist, glitched aesthetic

✅ No distractions — only the grid

✅ Works with any Minecraft version (just match the pack format)

How it looks
Every interface component — from the crafting table to the inventory screen — uses the iconic missing-texture texture.
No custom textures, no fancy gradients. Just the grid.

Why use this pack?
Perfect for hardcore worlds

Fun for trolling friends or content creation

Minimalist / glitch art enjoyers

Compatibility
Works with any resource pack-friendly version of Minecraft (Java Edition).
Just select the pack in your resource packs menu and enjoy.
